title: Native stream latency through the gateway
description: Isolated: a synthetic Claude stream-json peer streams 200 timestamped deltas through the real native host and an in-process gateway (temp FARMSLOT_HOME/root, never the operator gateway). Each node fails when a delta is lost or reordered, or when runner-to-client p95 exceeds its budget. Results and gateway performance snapshots are written under FARMSLOT_LATENCY_PROOF_OUTPUT.

idle.intent: Every delta reaches the client in order; p95 under 110 ms, loop p99 under 60 ms.

load.intent: All four viewers get every delta in order; fleet broadcasts stay steady.
